note: Scenario data set for the Sanad MRO Intelligence Hub.

engines.description: Engines in the shop (the command-centre list). One row per engine.

columns.workscope: Overhaul, Performance restoration or Hospital visit
columns.workstation: Gate and bay where the engine is worked
columns.planned_hours: Planned labour hours for the visit

schedule_tasks.description: Remaining planned work per engine, as a task network. The forecast is computed from this plus the live events.

columns.task_id: Task code, unique within the engine
columns.calendar: day = Gate day shift 07:30-17:30 (plus approved overtime); continuous = round-the-clock coverage
columns.needs: External gate: part:<id> (must have arrived), tool:<id> (must be at the gate), release:<job card> (supervisor release)
columns.planned_start: Earliest planned start (blank = as soon as predecessors finish)
columns.resequence_saving_h: Hours saved on this task when permitted preparatory work is re-sequenced
columns.disposition_extra_h: Hours added to this task when a blade repair disposition is in force

bay_slots.description: Reserved workstation windows. The installation window is the booked fan-module reassembly slot.

columns.window_end: Slot closes (after this the bay is allocated to other work)

parts.description: Part master for the parts that matter to the engines in the shop.

inventory.description: Stock by location. ready_at_gate_ts is when a unit could be at the workstation if it is requested.

columns.ready_at_gate_ts: Earliest time a unit could be at the gate, including any confirmation and transfer (blank if none on hand)
columns.approval_required: Who must approve the use of this stock

purchase_orders.description: Open purchase orders for critical parts.

po_events.description: Purchase order history. The latest row per PO gives the current promised arrival.

columns.promised_arrival_ts: Promised arrival at the delivery point after this event

columns.arrival_ts: Arrival at the delivery point if accepted

columns.calibration_due: Calibration valid to (blank if not required)

job_card_tools.description: Tools each job card calls for.

tool_events.description: Tool custody and sighting history. A camera detection is a sighting, not a custody change.

columns.event: Issued, Camera detection, Tool request raised, Handover signed or Checked in
columns.location: Where the tool was at this event
columns.custodian: Who holds custody after this event
columns.expected_available_ts: For an issue: when the tool is expected back

columns.title: Task
columns.key_care_point: The care point the job card stresses
columns.est_hours: Estimated working hours for the crew

job_card_steps.description: The steps of each job card, in order.

columns.title: Step title
columns.confirm: What to confirm before moving on

readiness_events.description: Readiness checks for a job card. The latest row per check gives its current state.

approvals.description: Decisions recorded by authorised people. The assistant never creates rows here.

columns.kind: expedite, work_release, overtime, resequence or disposition
columns.subject: What was decided

disposition_dependencies.description: What a finding disposition adds to the plan.

task_events.description: Actual task progress recorded on the shop floor.

progress_log.description: Labour hours booked per engine. The latest row per engine gives hours completed.

engine_stage_events.description: Repair stage history. The latest row per engine gives the current stage.

findings.description: Inspection findings raised on the shop floor.

columns.job_card: Job card it was found under

finding_measurements.description: Measurements taken for each finding, by blade zone.

columns.limit_mm: Serviceable limit in mm for this zone

inspection_limits.description: Serviceable limits from the Inspection Standards Manual.

columns.if_exceeded: What the manual requires when the limit is exceeded

staff.description: People in the scenario, by role identifier. No personal names are held.

columns.assigned_job_card: Job card they are assigned to, if any
columns.assigned_engine: Engine they are assigned to, if any

approval_matrix.description: Who may approve what, from the Approval Authority Matrix (QP-014).
